title: Unit Event — A Light Drawn Closer — Episode1 Signs

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu has been stuck unable to move forward since coming to stay with Kanade. Her father asks her what happened that day she spoke with her mother, but though she tries, Mafuyu finds herself unable to answer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, despite being physically healthy, you still couldn't taste anything?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was told that it was very likely a psychological manifestation of the stress I was experiencing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Then, we should take our time and slowly ease the burden on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'll try finding a good clinic or hospital...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The lavender tea you brought over the other day. It has a very nice aroma to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's supposed to be quite soothing, so I hope you get a chance to drink it during breaks and such.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
There's something I need to give you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, it came back the other day from repairs. It was the one you were using before, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Please continue looking after Mafuyu for me, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And feel free to contact me if anything comes up, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (She seems to be doing much better now compared to before.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I'm glad we managed to find out the cause of her inability to taste anything.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (For Mafuyu's sake, I want to improve the current situation as fast as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I still know very little about her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I had no idea that she couldn't taste anything or that she was suffering so much mentally until just recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (And I still don't have a clear picture as to why she was feeling so stressed...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (For the sake of her health, I need to learn more about her.)
